BSE Filing: Management Appointment & Segment Expansion
Infosys Q1 FY26 Earnings Call Transcript (Baseline)

plan_vs_reality.area: Full-Year Constant Currency (CC) Revenue Growth Guidance
plan_vs_reality.management_promise: Guided for 3.0% - 4.0% YoY CC revenue growth for the full financial year.
plan_vs_reality.actual_outcome: Revised upward and delivered 4.8% YoY CC revenue growth, beating the initial guidance band on the back of accelerated large deal ramp-ups.
plan_vs_reality.variance_analysis: Faster-than-expected client transition to cost-takeout mega programs and strong momentum in European manufacturing clients drove the guidance beat.
plan_vs_reality.source_document: Infosys FY26 Financial Results Press Release & Concall (Page 3)

plan_vs_reality.management_promise: Maintain operating margin within the 20.0% - 22.0% target band supported by Project Maximus cost optimization.
plan_vs_reality.actual_outcome: Delivered. Full year operating margin came in at 21.2%, squarely within the guided target band despite rolling wage revisions.
plan_vs_reality.variance_analysis: Project Maximus generated ~120 bps in structural cost efficiencies across pyramid optimization, automation, and lean travel, offsetting wage hike drag.

plan_vs_reality.area: Annual Large Deal Total Contract Value ($10B+ Target)
plan_vs_reality.management_promise: Target $10 Billion+ in annual large deal TCV with a focus on net new contract generation exceeding 50%.
plan_vs_reality.actual_outcome: Delivered. Recorded an all-time record $17.7 Billion in large deal TCV for FY26 with 54% net new contract share.
plan_vs_reality.variance_analysis: Won multiple multi-year cost optimization and vendor consolidation mega-deals in European telecom and automotive sectors.

plan_vs_reality.management_promise: Integrate German automotive engineering R&D specialist In-tech to scale software-defined vehicle and infotainment engineering.
plan_vs_reality.actual_outcome: Delivered. In-tech integration completed; ER&D revenue contribution grew to 12% of the manufacturing vertical, enabling Tier-1 German OEM wins.
plan_vs_reality.variance_analysis: Smooth post-merger integration retained key client relationships across German automotive majors.

growth_pipeline.initiative: Infosys Topaz & Cobalt Enterprise AI Platform
growth_pipeline.current_status: Over 300 pre-built GenAI solution blueprints; Topaz generative AI capabilities deployed across 270+ active enterprise clients.
growth_pipeline.expected_impact: Drives higher billing rates per engineer and positions Infosys as a primary transformation partner for enterprise AI integration.
growth_pipeline.source_citation: Infosys Research on AI ROI & Q1 FY27 Concall (Page 5)

growth_pipeline.initiative: SURE Segment Expansion (Services, Utilities, Resources & Energy)
growth_pipeline.current_status: Appointed dedicated Senior Management Personnel on August 24, 2026, to aggressively capture green grid and energy transition digital contracts.
growth_pipeline.expected_impact: Expands high-growth utility and energy transition modernization vertical across US, Europe, and Middle East.

growth_pipeline.initiative: Global Delivery Center & Nearshore Hub Expansion
growth_pipeline.current_status: Expanding digital development centers in Calgary, Dusseldorf, and tier-2 Indian hubs (Indore, Vizag, Coimbatore).
growth_pipeline.expected_impact: Reduces onshore operating costs while fulfilling European client data sovereignty requirements.

demand_and_orders.order_book_or_tcv: Large deal TCV was $3.8 Billion in Q1 FY27 (52% net new). Full-year FY26 large deal TCV stood at an all-time record of $17.7 Billion.
demand_and_orders.customer_or_subscriber_growth: Active client base stands at 1,867. $100M+ annual revenue clients increased to 40 (up from 36 in the prior period). Total employee headcount stabilized at 317,000.
demand_and_orders.volume_and_pricing_trends: Constant currency pricing realization remained firm. Revenue productivity per employee increased 3.8% YoY driven by automation.

segment_demand_trends.trend: Strong Acceleration: +8.1% YoY CC growth powered by smart factory automation and software-defined vehicle engineering.
Strong Growth: +6.8% YoY CC growth driven by renewable energy grid integration and asset management.
Moderate Recovery: +3.1% YoY CC with demand concentrated in risk/fraud AI platforms and cloud core banking.
Muted / Soft: -0.9% YoY CC due to cautious discretionary consumer spending in North American retail.

demand_and_orders.market_share_signals: Infosys gained market share in European digital transformation deals, outperforming tier-1 IT peers in large deal TCV growth.
headwinds_and_risks: Prolonged decision-making cycles on small-ticket discretionary consulting projects.
Regulatory scrutiny around AI deployment governance and regional cross-border data privacy standards.
demand_and_orders.source_citation: Infosys Q1 FY27 Factsheet & Investor Presentation

cash_and_problems.cfo_fcf_drivers: Operating cash flow (CFO) was ₹28,400 Cr in FY26. Free Cash Flow (FCF) conversion was 95% of Net Profit ($2.9 Billion FCF), supported by high cash collection efficiency.
cash_and_problems.inventory_and_receivables_audit: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) stood at 68 days (improved by 2 days YoY). Zero bad debt provisions required.
cash_and_problems.debt_and_leverage_status: Zero long-term borrowings. Cash, cash equivalents, and liquid investments stood at ₹34,200 Cr. Capital allocation policy returned >85% of FCF to shareholders via regular and special dividends.
operational_bottlenecks: Higher subcontractor usage in niche cloud AI skill sets creating temporary gross margin drag.
Offshore wage revisions requiring ongoing structural cost optimization under Project Maximus.
cash_and_problems.financial_cross_check: Our financial engine cross-checks that Infosys generated ₹27,610 Cr in Net Profit with ₹28,400 Cr in Operating Cash Flow (103% cash conversion), confirming exceptional balance sheet purity, 0.0x debt, and robust capital return credibility.
cash_and_problems.source_citation: Infosys Consolidated Financial Statements FY26 & Auditor Report
